title: Ocean-Fresh Vietnamese Fruit Sashimi
description: A refreshing and energizing Vietnamese dish featuring a mix of sashimi-cut fruits, carefully selected for their springy texture and low-sodium content.

ingredients.name: Papaya
ingredients.notes: Honeydew or muskmelon varieties work well

ingredients.name: Dragon Fruit
ingredients.notes: Look for varieties with vibrant pink or yellow skin

ingredients.name: Watermelon
ingredients.notes: Seedless or with seeds, your choice

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.notes: Optional, for a touch of sweetness

instructions: Chill the fruits in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Grate the ginger and set aside.
Cut the fruits into small, sashimi-style pieces, about 1/4 inch thick.
Place the chilled fruits on a large serving platter or individual plates.
Drizzle the sesame oil over the fruits and sprinkle with grated ginger.
If desired, drizzle with a touch of honey for sweetness.
Garnish with fresh mint leaves and lime wedges.
